checks.fact: OS Terrain 5 is a digital terrain model of Great Britain.
OS Terrain 5 uses 5 m post spacing.
OS Terrain 5 has 5 m interval contours.
OS Terrain 5 is produced from photogrammetry.
OS Terrain 5 is updated every three months.
OS Terrain 5 typical accuracy is described as greater than 2 m RMSE.
OS Terrain 50 is a low-resolution DTM.
OS Terrain 50 uses 50 m post spacing.
OS Terrain 50 has 10 m interval contours.
OS Terrain 50 is appropriate for broad-area applications.
Neither OS Terrain product should override EA 1 m LIDAR for parcel-edge elevation where valid EA coverage exists.

promotion_rule: Exact revision 14 runtime output plus remote integrity readback is required before promoting any parcel height-difference value.
